authorization: User explicitly requests promotion of the reference weighting logic and recording of per-joint confidence/weight rules as a future priority.
historical_validation: validation.json remains the completed experiment-time decision before promotion. This file records the later mainline selection; it does not rewrite that historical result.
scene_replay_scope: Independent Stage/ground replay from unchanged raw image pairs, strict points and calibration. No fitted mesh is stored in scene_transforms.npz; old body viewers remain historical and must not represent reference25.
limitations: Reference25 improves aggregate arm agreement and leg indexed motion but worsens some elbow/wrist slots and fixed-original-quality RMS; no universal joint accuracy claim.
25 px / 80 mm / confidence floor 0.6 are provisional shared engineering parameters, not calibrated per-joint probabilities.

scope: Separate detector confidence, stereo geometry diagnostics, and effective fit weights.
Define ordinary versus extreme anomalies by joint, anatomical side, view visibility and geometry sensitivity.
Check elbow/wrist, knee and ankle tails and interactions with shared shape and pose priors; do not tune only one event.
Use complete same-source controlled windows and cross-capture/independent labels when available; retain all rejected states.
next_priority.provisional_rule: Keep shared reference25 until a separately recorded controlled comparison supports a replacement.

validation_goal: Selected result and effective weights match the reference25 saved run, reproduction arguments resolve to identical numeric controls, frozen 448-frame controls and baseline Stage selection remain unchanged.
stop_conditions: Missing/mismatched selected artifacts or reproduction parameters: report unavailable/mismatch; do not change gates or refit to hide it.
No detector, triangulation, temporal/contact or Stage algorithm changes in this promotion.
